chunks: Sulaymān ibn Khālid asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
"Does one who has washed the deceased perform ghusl (ritual bath)?" He said: "Yes."
He said: "Then what about one who placed him into the grave?" He said: "No, he only touched the clothes."
ai.seo_question: Does a person who washes or buries a deceased body need to perform ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about ritual purity in relation to the deceased. It states that the one who washes the deceased must perform ghusl, whereas the one who only places the deceased into the grave does not, because he has only touched the clothing.
